name: h200
description: NVIDIA H200 SXM5 (GH100, Hopper, sm_90) at its 1980 MHz boost clock: one Vortex core per SM; the chip is the H100's (h100) with HBM3e.

sources.SM (all core knobs), NUM_CORES, L2, PLAT: Inherited from h100: H200 is the H100 SXM5's GH100 (132 SMs, 50 MB L2, 1980 MHz boost) with 141 GB of HBM3e (NVIDIA H200 data sheet)
sources.PLATFORM_MEMORY_DATA_RATE, PLATFORM_MEMO: 6 HBM3e stacks at 4.8 TB/s, modelled as the H100's 32 HBM3 channels at 9375 MT/s: 32 x 16 B x 9375 MT/s = 4.8 TB/s, the card's bandwidth
sources.L2_LINK_LATENCY, PLATFORM_MEMORY_LATENCY: Inherited from h100 (same die and SM-to-L2 network), calibrated there against the measured H100 pointer chase. Little's law at this bandwidth (386 cycles x 2424 B/cycle / (64 banks x 64 B) = 228) keeps the 256-entry L2 MSHR
sources.reference: fp32_lanes is the vendor FP32 core count (FP32 FMA lanes per chip, clock-free); dram_bandwidth_gbs the vendor peak. Checked by ci/profile_check.py. Latencies inherited from h100 (same GH100 die and L2; the HBM3e array timing is HBM3's). Accel-Sim models this card: GPGPU-Sim tested-cfg SM90_H200
